title: PP2 Graduation Ceremony 2026: Celebrating Our Young Achievers
excerpt: Our PP2 graduating class celebrated their milestone in colorful academic gowns with choral verses, certificate presentations, and family blessings.
body:
Our PP2 graduating class marked a wonderful milestone today in our annual graduation ceremony! Dressed in full academic gowns, the pupils performed heartwarming recitations, choral verses, and songs for an audience of proud parents and guardians.

Headteacher Mrs. Grace Muthoni personally presented each graduate with their certificate of completion and a special gift, commending their growth in literacy, numeracy, and character.

Congratulations to our bright class! They are thoroughly prepared, confident, and eager to step into Grade 1.

title: Exciting School Trip: Annual Excursion & Poolside Picnic
excerpt: Pupils enjoyed an unforgettable outdoor excursion complete with scenic gardens, recreational play, and a communal lunch picnic by the pool.
body:
At Gracious Love Academy, we believe learning extends far beyond classroom walls. Our pupils participated in an unforgettable excursion day featuring guided nature walks, recreational games, and a joyful communal picnic.

Activities like this strengthen social bonding, encourage teamwork, and create cherished memories that inspire children throughout their school journey.

title: Playground Upgrades & Safe Outdoor Learning Zones
excerpt: We have expanded our playground facilities with safe adventure equipment, slides, swings, and climbing sets to foster active, healthy physical play.
body:
We are delighted to announce that new recreational and physical education equipment has been installed on our campus! Pupils are loving the new adventure play sets, swings, and climbing frame.

Physical play is a vital cornerstone of Kenya's Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC), developing fine motor skills, coordination, and resilience.

title: Term 1 & Term 2 Open Days: Welcoming Prospective Families
excerpt: Parents considering admission for PP1 through Grade 6 are invited to tour our classrooms, meet teachers, and experience our warm learning community.
body:
We warmly welcome all prospective parents from Jomoko, Njomoko, and the broader Thika community to our campus Open Days. Tour our facilities, meet our dedicated teachers, and see how our small class sizes make a difference.

Time: Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM | Saturdays 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Location: Jomoko, near Kingdom Seekers Church, behind SK Suites, Thika

Admissions are ongoing across all levels.
